correctness.rationale: The all-placement containment linear program is bounded by a nonnegative balanced-normal certificate whose orientation-dependent expression is strictly greater away from canonical alignment. Explicit trigonometric estimates establish the needed strictness for all m≡1,2 (mod 3). A support-function argument verifies sharpness and two pairs of support inequalities force the unique center. The divisible-by-three case follows by squared-norm averaging. Extracted verify.py independently reproduced 198 small-to-large shape checks and 80 orientation-specific LP checks; finite tests supplement, not replace, the analytic proof.

value.rationale: The largest equilateral triangle is a canonical extremal geometry invariant of each regular polygon. The proof resolves joint free translation and orientation uniformly, specifies an exact trigonometric answer in every integer side count, identifies all optimizing triangles, and gives the reciprocal tight circumscription law. It is a genuine family-wide classification, not a sampled numerical exercise.
